<description>
The cs_main requirement was never made explicit. The nTx field is modified when the block data is received and m_chain_tx_count is modified when all ancestors' block data has been received. Because of this, reading nTx from the getblockheader RPC may race as it does not acquire cs_main. Also, m_chain_tx_count may race in getchaintxstats if a pruned node redownloads a block via getblockfrompeer or if the node is running assumeutxo and tries to read m_chain_tx_count while it is being written to.
</description>
